title: sing-box config generator · Build and download JSON locally
description: Paste node links, choose Android, iOS, macOS, Linux or Windows, and download a complete sing-box JSON configuration. Runs in your browser with 1.13 / 1.14 presets and no generator installation.
heading: Build your sing-box configuration
intro: Paste your nodes, choose a device, and download a JSON file to import. Routing defaults and policy groups are already set up.
noscript: The generator needs JavaScript. You can also download the repository and generate configurations locally with the CLI.
placeholder:
Paste one node share link per line

Or paste native sing-box nodes JSON
input_help: Supports Naive HTTPS, Hysteria2, Trojan, Shadowsocks and VLESS. One link per line, or native sing-box nodes JSON; up to 200 nodes and 1 MB.
file_label: Or read a local file (JSON / TXT)
privacy_note: Nodes stay in this tab. No uploads or automatic storage; refreshing clears them.
core_help: Match your client core. The experimental 1.15 presets target 1.15.0-alpha.12.
empty_result: Complete the first two steps to generate your full configuration here.
preview_help: The configuration contains your node details; keep it on your own device.
guides_heading: From your first import to your next update
first_1: Install an official client and check its core version.
first_2: Paste your nodes, choose a device and generate.
first_3: Download the JSON and import it as a local profile.
update_body: Read your saved nodes.json, update the nodes and generate again. Replace the local profile in your client. Keep the same nodes file when updating templates.
trouble_body: Check the core version and node details first. Try RealIP for app compatibility issues. On Linux / Windows, start with local HTTP / SOCKS mode to check your nodes.
technical_help: Public Raw JSON uses placeholder nodes so you can inspect the default policies. The CLI shares its node parser and renderer with this page and requires Node.js 22+.
faq: No. Node parsing, configuration composition and file export run in your browser. Nodes are not automatically stored.
How do I export a JSON file?
Paste your nodes, choose a device and generate. Click Download sing-box.json, then import the file as a local profile.
In Advanced, match the core version shown in your client's About screen or sing-box version.
Is public Raw JSON my personal configuration?
Public Raw JSON uses placeholder nodes. Use the generator to download a JSON file containing your own nodes.
